decisions.decision: The Board set construction hours of 7 AM to 5 PM Monday through Friday and 8 AM to 4 PM on Saturday, with no construction on Sundays or federal or state holidays.
decisions.quote: the board set construction hours of 7 am - 5 pm, monday through friday, 8 am - 4 pm on saturday.

decisions.decision: Conditions added to the draft Decision: a third-party monitor, a GEI letter confirming all outstanding requirements are met, at least one foot of freeboard from the 100-year storm, and Pope Road not to be used for a construction entrance.
Because the meetings were held virtually, the Decision could be executed through DocuSign.
